empty.nothingTitle: The deep agent hasn't learned anything yet
empty.nothingText: Knowledge appears after the first finished run. Stopped runs don't teach.
empty.offText: {audience, select, panel {The author can turn it on.} other {Turn it on on the deep agent's page — runs will start remembering where they found what.}}

lines.scopeAll: Runs get {active, plural, one {# record} other {all # records}} · knowledge takes {percent}% of the space
lines.scopeSome: For any question, runs get {always} of {active, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} · knowledge takes {percent}% of the space
lines.doesNotFit: {beyond, plural, one {# doesn't fit} other {# don't fit}}: records confirmed less often drop out first, and among equals the oldest.
lines.byTopic: {beyond} more only on the question's topic: a run gives up to half the space to the records closest in meaning to the question, the rest to the most confirmed, and among equals the newest.
lines.selfLearningOff: Self-learning is off: runs don't get this knowledge and don't add to it.{audience, select, panel { The author can turn it on.} other {}}
lines.outdated: {outdated, plural, one {# more is outdated — runs don't get it.} other {# more are outdated — runs don't get them.}}
lines.lessonsOff: Lessons don't go into runs now — an administrator turned them off. Facts and “searched — found nothing” go as usual.
lines.selectionNoModel: Selection by meaning is off: no model is chosen for it — an administrator chooses it in the panel, under “Models”. While it is off, the most confirmed records fill the space.
lines.selectionFailed: Selection by meaning is off: the {model} model didn't answer or refused — an administrator can check it in the panel, under “Models”. While it is off, the most confirmed records fill the space.
lines.selectionPreparing: Selection by meaning doesn't cover all records yet: {pending, plural, one {# is} other {# are}} still being prepared for it; until then they go into runs by confirmations.
